guarded_search.selection_rule: validation Brier ascending; ROI descending tie-break; name ascending
limitations: Single-pick equal-stake diagnostic; not two-leg monthly paper profit.
Minimum counts are a screening guard, not proof of statistical significance.
Model/tipster overlap is required; never substitute a market proxy.
Hundreds of candidates require independent forward confirmation.
No sport-specific weights fit without sufficient per-sport data.
Git commit timestamps are repository evidence, not independent timestamp certification.
Conservative capture=max(commit timestamp, artifact generated_at). All snapshots pregame.
Noon quote availability is not proven; publisher outcomes not independently official verified.
Resolved paired subset has missingness bias; no population or future ROI claim.
In-sample ranking is retrospective exploration, NOT a deployable winner.
Monthly loss limit remains 50000 KRW; no production changes.
